title: sonchus spinosus
intro: Sonchus spinosus, commonly known as spiny sow thistle, is a plant species in the dandelion family, known for its prickly appearance and edible leaves. The health benefits of Sonchus spinosus include its ability to support liver function, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its use as a diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of Sonchus spinosus include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
